h: Nkechi Blessing thanks God after nasty bathtub fall in the UK
p: Actress Nkechi Blessing says she narrowly escaped serious injury after slipping in a bathtub while preparing for a photoshoot in the UK, and has thanked God for her recovery.
body: Nollywood actress Nkechi Blessing has shared a frightening experience she had while in the United Kingdom.

In a video posted on Instagram on Friday, 13 November 2026, the actress said she had slipped in her bathtub earlier that day while getting ready for a photoshoot. She said she lost her footing, tumbled out of the tub and landed on her back and bottom on the floor. She credited her physical strength for helping her recover quickly, saying the outcome could otherwise have been far worse.
In the caption, she thanked God for protecting her and asked her followers to help her give thanks.
Colleagues and fans flooded her comments with messages of relief and prayers. The actress has been in the news this week after publicly addressing speculation about her love life.
more: Nkechi Blessing slipped in a bathtub in the UK.
She says the fall could have been far worse.
